profile.headline: Software Developer | Musician | Entrepreneur
profile.geoLocationName: Charleston County, South Carolina, United States
profile.summary:
After more than a decade of experience in the music industry as a performer and educator, I've embraced the tech world with open arms, adding Software Developer to my eclectic career path. My journey in tech began with graduating from the JRS Coding School, which paved the way for my current role as a Full Stack Engineer at Code|+|Trust in Mt Pleasant, SC.

In the time since joining the team, I've delved deeply into developing React applications for a variety of clients, further honing my skills in full stack development. My role involves not just coding but also collaborating closely with team members and clients to tailor solutions that best fit their needs, a process that continuously challenges and enhances my technical and interpersonal skills.

While my weekdays are dedicated to coding and client projects, my evenings and weekends are reserved for music. As a committed performer, I play weekly shows around the low-country, continuing to engage with my musical roots. This balance of my technological career and musical passion enriches my life in unique ways. It allows me to seamlessly integrate the discipline and creativity of software development with the expressive and dynamic world of music. This blend defines my professional journey, showcasing that a fulfilling career can indeed be built by aligning one's skills and passions.
